# Data dictionary

<!-- Generated by `hpdq docs` from the dbt manifest. Do not edit by hand: change the
     descriptions in dbt/models/**/*.yml or dbt/seeds/_seeds.yml and re-run. -->

Generated from the dbt project. Prices are integer rupiah per unit. Dates are WIB business dates.
Timestamps are UTC. Lineage: every fact row carries the `snapshot_id` of the raw file it came from.

## Marts (contract enforced)

### `agg_volatility`

Volatility per commodity x province (and national) over each series' last 60 observations.

**Grain:** one row per `commodity_id` × `area_type` × `area_name`.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `commodity_id` | varchar | PIHPS commodity id (see dim_commodity). |
| `area_type` | varchar | national or province. |
| `area_name` | varchar | Source province name, or "Semua Provinsi" for the national series. |
| `as_of_date` | date | Last observation in the window. |
| `window_start_date` | date | First observation in the window. |
| `n_returns` | bigint | Log returns in the window (up to 59). |
| `volatility_60` | double | Sample std. dev. of daily log returns in the window. |
| `mean_abs_dod_pct` | double | Mean absolute day-over-day change, percent. |
| `max_abs_dod_pct` | double | Largest absolute day-over-day change, percent. |

### `dim_commodity`

The 21 commodities: our names and expected unit next to the source's current reference list (name, denomination), so a rename or unit change is visible.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `commodity_id` | varchar | PIHPS commodity id, e.g. com_13. |
| `commodity_name` | varchar | Indonesian name as in the source. |
| `commodity_name_en` | varchar | English name. |
| `category_id` | varchar | PIHPS category id, e.g. cat_7 (red chilli). |
| `category_name_en` | varchar | English category name. |
| `unit` | varchar | Unit the source's reference list declares (our contract with it). |
| `unit_note` | varchar | Known caveats about the unit (cooking oil kg vs litre). |
| `plausible_min_idr` | bigint | Lowest price the validity check accepts (seed; see its derivation). |
| `plausible_max_idr` | bigint | Highest price the validity check accepts. |
| `source_name` | varchar | Name in the source's latest reference list. |
| `source_denomination` | varchar | Unit in the source's latest reference list. |
| `source_checked_at` | timestamp with time zone | When that reference list was fetched (UTC). |

### `dim_province`

Indonesia's 38 provinces and the source province that reports for each.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `iso_code` | varchar | ISO 3166-2:ID code, e.g. ID-PA. |
| `province_name` | varchar | Indonesian name. |
| `province_name_en` | varchar | English name. |
| `island_group` | varchar | ISO 3166-2 geographical unit (Sumatera, Jawa, Nusa Tenggara, ...). |
| `split_from_iso_code` | varchar | For the four 2022 provinces, the province they were split from. |
| `legal_basis` | varchar | The law that created the province (2022 provinces only). |
| `source_province_id` | integer | PIHPS province whose data covers this province. |
| `source_province_name` | varchar | Name of that PIHPS province. |
| `mapping_type` | varchar | one_to_one, or split (the source province also covers other provinces). |

### `dim_source_province`

The 34 provinces PIHPS reports and the current provinces each covers.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `source_province_id` | integer | PIHPS province id. |
| `source_province_name` | varchar | Province name as published by PIHPS. |
| `mapping_type` | varchar | one_to_one, or split. |
| `current_province_count` | bigint | 1, or 4 for Papua and 2 for Papua Barat. |
| `current_provinces` | varchar | Today's provinces covered, comma-separated. |
| `current_iso_codes` | varchar | Their ISO 3166-2:ID codes, comma-separated. |
| `island_group` | varchar | ISO 3166-2 geographical unit. |

### `fct_price_city_daily`

Daily price per commodity x sample city, each city assigned to its current (38-province) province. Basis for a true 38-province view (ADR-006).

**Grain:** one row per `price_date` × `commodity_id` × `source_province_name` × `city_name`.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `price_date` | date | Business date the price refers to (WIB). |
| `commodity_id` | varchar | PIHPS commodity id (see dim_commodity). |
| `source_province_name` | varchar | The source province the city is reported under (34-province list). |
| `city_name` | varchar | Sample city (kota) or regency (kabupaten) as published, trimmed. |
| `province_iso_code` | varchar | Current province (ISO 3166-2:ID) the city belongs to today. |
| `price_idr` | bigint | Average retail price in this city's surveyed markets, rupiah per unit. |
| `prev_price_date` | date | Date of the previous observation for this city. |
| `days_since_prev` | bigint | Calendar days since the previous observation. |
| `dod_pct` | double | Percent change vs the previous observation. |
| `wow_pct` | double | Percent change vs the latest observation on or before D-7. |
| `is_revised` | boolean | The source changed this value between fetches. |
| `snapshot_id` | varchar | Raw snapshot the value comes from. |

### `fct_price_daily`

Daily price per commodity x source province (traditional markets, as published by PIHPS), with day-over-day and week-over-week change, volatility, and the gap to the source's own national figure. Only observed prices: a missing report is a missing row, never a guess.

**Grain:** one row per `price_date` × `commodity_id` × `source_province_name`.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `price_date` | date | Business date the price refers to (WIB). |
| `commodity_id` | varchar | PIHPS commodity id (see dim_commodity). |
| `source_province_id` | integer | PIHPS province id (one of the 34 pre-2022 provinces). |
| `source_province_name` | varchar | Province name as published (see dim_source_province for today's provinces). |
| `price_idr` | bigint | Average retail price, integer rupiah per unit. |
| `national_price_idr` | bigint | The source's national figure for the same commodity and day. |
| `gap_to_national_pct` | double | Percent difference from the national figure (+10 = 10% above). |
| `prev_price_date` | date | Date of the previous observation in this series. |
| `prev_price_idr` | bigint | Previous observed price. |
| `days_since_prev` | bigint | Calendar days since the previous observation (3 after a weekend). |
| `dod_pct` | double | Percent change vs the previous observation ("day-over-day" in business days). |
| `week_ago_date` | date | Latest observation on or before D-7 (null if older than 14 days). |
| `wow_pct` | double | Percent change vs week_ago_date. |
| `log_return` | double | ln(price / previous price). |
| `volatility_20` | double | Sample std. dev. of the last 20 log returns (null until 20 exist). |
| `is_revised` | boolean | The source changed this value between fetches. |
| `snapshot_id` | varchar | Raw snapshot the value comes from (lineage back to the raw file). |

### `fct_price_national_daily`

The source's national figure ("Semua Provinsi") per commodity and day.

**Grain:** one row per `price_date` × `commodity_id`.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `price_date` | date | Business date the price refers to (WIB). |
| `commodity_id` | varchar | PIHPS commodity id (see dim_commodity). |
| `price_idr` | bigint | National average retail price, integer rupiah per unit (as published). |
| `prev_price_date` | date | Date of the previous observation. |
| `days_since_prev` | bigint | Calendar days since the previous observation. |
| `dod_pct` | double | Percent change vs the previous observation. |
| `week_ago_date` | date | Latest observation on or before D-7 (null if older than 14 days). |
| `wow_pct` | double | Percent change vs week_ago_date. |
| `volatility_20` | double | Sample std. dev. of the last 20 log returns (null until 20 exist). |
| `provinces_reporting` | bigint | Source provinces with an observed price for this commodity and day. |
| `is_revised` | boolean | The source changed this value between fetches. |
| `snapshot_id` | varchar | Raw snapshot the value comes from. |

## Seeds (reference data)

### `commodities`

The 21 PIHPS commodities with English names, the unit the source's reference list declares, and a deliberately wide plausible price range for the validity check. Cooking oil: the reference list says kg, the PIHPS FAQ says litre; shown as published, with a note. Ranges were computed by analyses/plausible_price_ranges.sql ([p0.5/3, p99.5x3] of all province and city prices, rounded outward to 2 significant digits) on data from 2026-08-03 to 2026-11-12; they are recalibrated on the full history in M6.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `plausible_min_idr` | bigint | Lowest price (rupiah per unit) the validity check accepts. |
| `plausible_max_idr` | bigint | Highest price (rupiah per unit) the validity check accepts. |
| `commodity_id` | varchar | PIHPS id, e.g. com_13. |
| `commodity_name` | varchar | Indonesian name as in the source reference list. |
| `commodity_name_en` | varchar | English name. |
| `category_id` | varchar | PIHPS category id (cat_1 rice ... cat_10 sugar). |
| `category_name_en` | varchar | English category name. |
| `unit_note` | varchar | Known caveat about the unit, if any. |
| `unit` | varchar | Unit declared by the source reference list (the contract the unit check guards). |

### `pihps_province_map`

How the 34 provinces PIHPS still reports map to today's 38. 32 are one-to-one. "Papua" covers today's Papua, Papua Selatan, Papua Tengah and Papua Pegunungan; "Papua Barat" covers Papua Barat and Papua Barat Daya. Ids and names come from the source's GetRefProvince list (a singular test fails if they drift).

**Grain:** one row per `pihps_province_id` × `iso_code`.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pihps_province_id` | integer | Province id in the PIHPS reference list. |
| `source_province_name` | varchar | Province name exactly as PIHPS publishes it. |
| `iso_code` | varchar | Current province (ISO 3166-2:ID). |
| `mapping_type` | varchar | one_to_one, or split (the source province now covers several provinces). |

### `pihps_split_cities`

The sample cities of the two split source provinces, assigned to their current province. A singular test fails if the source reports a city in a split province that is not listed here, so a new city can never be assigned silently.

**Grain:** one row per `source_province_name` × `city_name`.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `source_province_name` | varchar | Split source province (Papua or Papua Barat). |
| `city_name` | varchar | Sample city as published by PIHPS. |
| `iso_code` | varchar | Current province of the city (ISO 3166-2:ID). |

### `provinces`

Indonesia's 38 provinces since the 2022 Papua splits. Key: ISO 3166-2:ID code. Island group = the ISO 3166-2 geographical unit (Bali is in "Nusa Tenggara"). Source: ISO 3166-2:ID; legal basis of the four new provinces: UU 14, 15, 16/2022 (25 July 2022) and UU 29/2022 (December 2022).

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `iso_code` | varchar | ISO 3166-2:ID code, e.g. ID-PA. |
| `province_name` | varchar | Indonesian name. |
| `province_name_en` | varchar | English name (ISO 3166-2 listing). |
| `island_group` | varchar | ISO 3166-2 geographical unit. |
| `split_from_iso_code` | varchar | For provinces created in 2022, the province they were split from. |
| `legal_basis` | varchar | The law that created the province (only for the 2022 provinces). |

## Intermediate

### `int_prices__current`

The source's current value for every (price type, commodity, date, area): all areas of a date come from the most recently fetched snapshot containing that date.

**Grain:** one row per `price_type_id` × `commodity_id` × `price_date` × `area_key`.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `is_revised` |  | The value differed between snapshots that contained this cell. |
| `n_snapshots` |  | How many snapshots contained this cell. |

### `int_prices__series`

Observed prices as time series per (price type, commodity, area) with day-over-day, week-over-week, log return and 20-observation volatility.

**Grain:** one row per `price_type_id` × `commodity_id` × `area_key` × `price_date`.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `price_idr` |  |  |
| `days_since_prev` |  | Calendar days since the previous observation (3 after a weekend). |

## Staging

### `stg_pihps__grid_rows`

One row per (snapshot, row) of the commodity grids: national (level 0), province (1) or city (2). City rows get their province from row order.

**Grain:** one row per `snapshot_id` × `row_idx`.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `area_type` |  |  |
| `area_name_raw` |  | Name exactly as published (some carry trailing spaces). |
| `area_name` |  | Trimmed name. |
| `parent_province_name` |  | For city rows, the province row above it; null otherwise. |
| `area_key` |  | Stable identity across snapshots ("national", province name, "Province / City"). |

### `stg_pihps__prices`

One row per (snapshot, area, date) price cell. price_raw keeps the published text; price_idr is set only when the text is a well-formed rupiah amount like "16,500".

**Grain:** one row per `snapshot_id` × `area_key` × `price_date`.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `price_date` |  |  |
| `price_raw` |  | Published text, e.g. "16,500" or "-" (missing). |
| `is_missing` |  | True when the source published "-". |
| `price_idr` |  | Integer rupiah per unit; null when missing or not a well-formed amount. |

### `stg_pihps__ref_commodities`

The source's commodity reference list, one row per (snapshot, item).

### `stg_pihps__ref_provinces`

The source's province reference list, one row per (snapshot, province).

### `stg_pihps__snapshots`

One row per raw snapshot with its request parameters unpacked.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `snapshot_id` |  | File stem of the raw snapshot (request key, fetch time, sha256 prefix). |
| `parse_status` |  | ok, invalid_json, unexpected_shape or missing_meta (from the loader). |
